objective: Bounded failure evidence and canonical publication
acceptanceCriteria: Source reads/output are bounded and redacted; missing identity/coverage is explicit; dedupe/transport/auth failures cannot create speculative duplicates; canonical publication retains known evidence and existing #1 history.
nonGoals: No API pagination expansion, speculative intake resolution, blanket run enumeration, dual-issue cross-repository creation or automatic restart from incomplete evidence.
dependencies: #31 depends on #30. Both remain separate from the intake defect #1; historical run evidence in #1 comments must be preserved.
suggestedWorkBreakdown: Implement side-effect-free bounded collection #30 first, then exact-dedupe canonical publication #31 against its versioned artifact.

subIssues.title: Produce bounded redacted failure evidence without bulk run enumeration
subIssues.body: Make failure collection read-only with enforceable read/output budgets and explicit registered identity. See fully planned child #30. Bounded-stream fake sources record bytes/requests; check 20/24h/8/12k limits, secrets and giant lines; full Factory suite on Windows/Linux.

subIssues.title: Publish one canonical Factory failure issue with fail-closed deduplication
subIssues.body: Publish actionable failure evidence idempotently without losing it on dedupe or partial API failure. See fully planned child #31. Fake-gh state/exit/error fixtures and publisher golden bodies; exact-marker mismatch and ambiguous-create tests; full Factory suite.
